description: Test suite for usage accumulator functions, verifying behavior of merging, normalization, and resolution of usage data within the 'usage-accumulator' module.

methods.name: mergeUsageIntoAccumulator
methods.description: Merges usage data into an accumulator, updating totals and last call snapshot.

methods.name: createUsageAccumulator
methods.description: Initializes a new usage accumulator object.

methods.name: toNormalizedUsage
methods.description: Returns a normalized representation of the accumulated usage for billing purposes.

methods.name: toLastCallUsage
methods.description: Extracts the last call usage snapshot from an accumulator.

methods.name: resolveLastCallUsage
methods.description: Resolves the last call usage, preferring raw assistant data if available.
